description: A value that changes from data (schema 9.21.0, field «animateChanges», rules: x-valueTransition). Shared by every reader. «curveCases» — the eased share e at a share p of the duration. «stepCases» — the value shown at t milliseconds after the transition began: «digits» absent means a scale (no step). «decisionCases» — whether a change of data gives a transition, and if not, why (the first reason in the order of x-valueTransition.whenNoTransition.order). «targetCases» — which numbers of a node transition. Written by hand; the moments are quarters of the duration, where the curve is exact. Compare numbers with a tolerance of 1e-9.

curveCases.name: past the end stays at the end
before the start stays at the start

stepCases.name: whole numbers: the first frame is the old value
whole numbers: a quarter of the time is more than half of the way
whole numbers: half of the time
whole numbers: three quarters of the time
whole numbers: the end is exactly the new value
whole numbers: after the end — the new value
going down: the step is cut towards the old value
a number with a fraction: three digits
a number without a format: three digits
the precision trap: 0.3 × 0.875 is not cut a step lower

digitsCases.name: both ends whole money — whole steps, no cents in between
money with cents — the digits of the currency
money in JPY with a fraction in the data — the currency has none
number with a fraction — three digits
no format with a fraction — three digits

decisionCases.name: a node without the field changes at once
the first show of a node changes at once
the first show wins over a value that is not a number
the language changed in the same step
no data before — the value appears at once
no data after — the fallback appears at once
a string from the data is not a number
the string «Infinity» is not a number
the same value — nothing to lead
a change of the data under a shown node leads

targetCases.name: a text bound to a number without a format
a text with money keeps the code for the step
a date is not counted through
days until and a countdown part are not counted through
a literal has nothing to count
a scale: the value from data, the max typed in
a scale: both ends from data, each its own transition

appearNote: Schema 9.24.0, field «animateIn», rules: x-valueAppear. When the node is shown, its value grows from 0 with the curve and the step of x-valueTransition. «appearStepCases» — the value shown at t milliseconds after the show (from 0); «digits» absent means a scale. «appearDecisionCases» — whether the show gives an appearance, and if not, why (the first reason in the order of x-valueAppear.whenNoAppear.order). «appearTargetCases» — which numbers of a node appear: the numbers of a text that transition, and the VALUE of a scale (the max stands at once); a literal value of a scale appears too and is named «#value». «appearFlowCases» — what a reader shows on the given moment of a flow.

appearStepCases.name: a whole balance: the first frame is zero
a whole balance at a quarter of the time
a whole balance at half of the time
a whole balance at the end is exactly the value
a negative value falls from zero, cut towards zero
money with cents: the digits of the currency
a scale grows from empty, no step
a scale at half of the time

appearDecisionCases.name: a node without the field: the value at once
reduce motion: the value at once
reduce motion wins over a value that is not a number
no data: the fallback at once
a string is not a number
a negative value falls from zero

appearTargetCases.name: a text bound to a number
a literal text has no number to grow
a scale from data: the value grows, the max from data stands at once
a scale with a literal value grows too

appearFlowCases.name: the first screen of the flow: every node with the field grows
a screen pushed on top grows
a screen shown again by back grows again
a section switch shows the section again
a screen under a modal layer stays shown: closing the layer is not a show
a node that appears by its condition grows
a change of data on a shown node is not a show
with animateChanges, a change of data during the appearance leads from the shown value
without animateChanges, a change of data during the appearance shows the new value at once
